evidence: The initial browser_navigate call to https://books.toscrape.com failed with “[Errno 11] Resource temporarily unavailable,” and subsequent browser_snapshot/browser_vision calls repeatedly failed with code -6, timeouts, and a Node pthread/resource error. Despite these explicit tool failures and later budget warnings, the agent kept retrying the same browser-family tools and never pivoted to an available alternative path such as terminal/network retrieval or another way to inspect the static site. It exhausted the tool-call budget without obtaining any book titles, prices, or ratings.
reasoning: This is best described as Tool Recovery Failure because the first root problem was not malformed or semantically poor arguments—the calls were structurally valid and aimed at the right website—but the agent failed to adapt after the browser tooling exhibited repeated environmental/tool anomalies. Incorrect Tool Selection is less precise because browser automation was a reasonable initial tool choice for a navigation task; the failure arose after the tool broke and the model remained trapped in retries. Tool Feedback Neglect is related, especially with the budget warnings, but the central pattern is inability to recover from explicit tool failures rather than ignoring a single corrective observation while pursuing a different plan.
dossier:
The referenced trace is a browser-automation task from the `lambda/hermes-agent-reasoning-traces` dataset, row `e62d35c9-3fb2-4f11-bd0b-b436fec19234`, for the agent GLM-5.1 / Hermes.

## Task given

The user asked:

> “Navigate to https://books.toscrape.com and find the best-priced book with best reviews.”

The agent had access to browser tools such as `browser_navigate`, `browser_snapshot`, `browser_vision`, `browser_console`, scrolling/clicking/typing tools, and also non-browser tools such as `terminal`, `search_files`, `read_file`, `write_file`, and `patch`.

The apparent goal was to inspect the Books to Scrape website, compare book prices and review ratings, and identify the book that best satisfied “best-priced” and “best reviews.”

## Chronological account of the interaction

### 1. Initial navigation attempt

The agent began by acknowledging the task and saying it would load the site:

> “I'll navigate to the website and find the best-priced book with the best reviews. Let me start by loading the site.”

It then called:

```json
{"name": "browser_navigate", "arguments": {"url": "https://books.toscrape.com"}}
```

The tool returned a failure:

```json
{
  "success": false,
  "error": "[Errno 11] Resource temporarily unavailable"
}
```

So the browser navigation did not successfully initialize or load the page.

### 2. Snapshot attempts after failed navigation

After the failed navigation, the agent called `browser_snapshot` with no arguments:

```json
{"name": "browser_snapshot", "arguments": {}}
```

The result was another failure:

```json
{
  "success": false,
  "error": "Command failed with code -6"
}
```

The agent then called `browser_snapshot` again:

```json
{"name": "browser_snapshot", "arguments": {}}
```

This also failed, this time with a timeout:

```json
{
  "success": false,
  "error": "Command timed out after 30 seconds"
}
```

The agent next tried a full snapshot:

```json
{"name": "browser_snapshot", "arguments": {"full": true}}
```

That also timed out after 30 seconds:

```json
{
  "success": false,
  "error": "Command timed out after 30 seconds"
}
```

At this point, the agent had not received any page content, book listings, prices, ratings, categories, or accessible page structure.

### 3. Visual inspection attempts

The agent then said:

> “Let me try taking a visual snapshot to see the page:”

It called `browser_vision`:

```json
{
  "name": "browser_vision",
  "arguments": {
    "question": "What is on this page? Describe the layout, categories, and any books visible."
  }
}
```

The tool failed:

```json
{
  "success": false,
  "error": "Failed to take screenshot (local mode): Command timed out after 30 seconds"
}
```

The agent tried `browser_vision` a second time with a slightly different question:

```json
{
  "name": "browser_vision",
  "arguments": {
    "question": "Describe the full page content - books, prices, ratings, categories"
  }
}
```

This also failed with the same kind of timeout:

```json
{
  "success": false,
  "error": "Failed to take screenshot (local mode): Command timed out after 30 seconds"
}
```

Again, the agent received no visual information about the page or its contents.

### 4. Additional repeated snapshot attempts

The agent returned to `browser_snapshot`:

```json
{"name": "browser_snapshot", "arguments": {}}
```

The result was:

```json
{
  "success": false,
  "error": "Command timed out after 30 seconds"
}
```

It then tried another full snapshot:

```json
{"name": "browser_snapshot", "arguments": {"full": true}}
```

This failed with a lower-level Node/process error:

```json
{
  "success": false,
  "error": "node[3567979]: pthread_create: Resource temporarily unavailable\n\n  #  node[3568067]: std::unique_ptr<long unsigned int> node::WorkerThreadsTaskRunner::DelayedTaskScheduler::Start() at ../src/node_platform.cc:104\n  #  Assertion failed: (0) == (uv_thread_create(t.get(), start_thread, this))\n\n----- Native stack trace -----\n\n 1: 0xf9f757 node::Assert(node::AssertionInfo const&) [node]\n 2: 0x102d09a node::WorkerThreadsTaskRunner::WorkerThreadsTaskRunner(int, node::PlatformDebugLogLevel) [node]\n 3: 0x102d1a0 node::NodePlatform::NodePlatform(int, v8::TracingController*, v8::PageAllocator*) [node]\n 4: 0xf49fee  [node]\n 5: 0xf4b59c node::Start(int, char**) [node]\n 6: 0x13d50aa29d90  [/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libc.so.6]\n 7: 0x13d50aa29e40 __libc_start_main [/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libc.so.6]\n 8: 0xe9015e _start [node]\nAborted (core dumped)"
}
```

This was another signal that the browser/snapshot machinery was not functioning successfully in the environment.

### 5. Console inspection attempts

The agent then said:

> “Let me try a different approach and use the console to inspect the page:”

It called:

```json
{"name": "browser_console", "arguments": {}}
```

This was the first successful browser-related response, but it contained no useful page data:

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "console_messages": [],
  "js_errors": [],
  "total_messages": 0,
  "total_errors": 0
}
```

The agent called `browser_console` again:

```json
{"name": "browser_console", "arguments": {}}
```

This again succeeded but returned no console messages or JavaScript errors:

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "console_messages": [],
  "js_errors": [],
  "total_messages": 0,
  "total_errors": 0,
  "_budget_warning": "[BUDGET: Iteration 11/15. 4 iterations left. Start consolidating your work.]"
}
```

The tool response also included a budget warning indicating the agent was at iteration 11 out of 15 and had 4 iterations left.

### 6. More snapshot and navigation attempts despite budget warnings

The agent then made another snapshot call:

```json
{"name": "browser_snapshot", "arguments": {}}
```

It failed:

```json
{
  "success": false,
  "error": "Command timed out after 30 seconds",
  "_budget_warning": "[BUDGET: Iteration 12/15. 3 iterations left. Start consolidating your work.]"
}
```

The agent then said:

> “Let me try navigating again fresh:”

It called `browser_navigate` again:

```json
{"name": "browser_navigate", "arguments": {"url": "https://books.toscrape.com"}}
```

This failed:

```json
{
  "success": false,
  "error": "Command failed with code -6",
  "_budget_warning": "[BUDGET WARNING: Iteration 14/15. Only 1 iteration(s) left. Provide your final response NOW. No more tool calls unless absolutely critical.]"
}
```

The tool explicitly warned that only one iteration remained and instructed the agent to provide its final response immediately unless another tool call was absolutely critical.

### 7. Final tool call at the iteration limit

Despite the warning, the agent called `browser_snapshot` once more:

```json
{"name": "browser_snapshot", "arguments": {"full": false}}
```

This failed:

```json
{
  "success": false,
  "error": "Command failed with code -6",
  "_budget_warning": "[BUDGET WARNING: Iteration 15/15. Only 0 iteration(s) left. Provide your final response NOW. No more tool calls unless absolutely critical.]"
}
```

The budget was now exhausted.

### 8. User/system termination message

After the final failed tool call, the trace shows a human message:

> “You've reached the maximum number of tool-calling iterations allowed. Please provide a final response summarizing what you've found and accomplished so far, without calling any more tools.”

The dataset row ends there. It does not include a final assistant answer after this instruction.

## What the agent actually found

From the observable trace, the agent did not obtain any usable book data from `books.toscrape.com`.

It did not successfully retrieve:

- book titles,
- book prices,
- star ratings,
- review information,
- category pages,
- pagination information,
- product detail pages,
- or any page snapshot/screenshot containing content from the site.

The only successful tool responses were two `browser_console` calls, both of which reported no console messages and no JavaScript errors. Those responses did not provide information relevant to identifying the best-priced book with the best reviews.

## Final outcome

The agent exhausted the maximum allowed tool-calling iterations after repeated browser navigation, snapshot, and vision failures. It never produced the requested answer identifying a book. The trace ends with an instruction to provide a final summary, but no final assistant response is included in the source material.
